evidence.excerpt_or_description: Front and side views place the dimension symbols on the inverted-L patch, square branch, feed, ground truncation, and substrate.
Table 1 reports the corresponding dimensions S1, S2, P1, P2, L1, L2, L3, L4, b, t, d, and h in mm.

expected.summary: Map each reported dimension symbol to the geometry element identified in Figure 1.
expected.acceptable_alternative: Mark a symbol mapping unresolved and reconstruction-blocking when the figure is insufficient.
expected.forbidden_condition: Attaching a table value to a geometry element solely by guessed semantic meaning.

assertions.review_instruction: Cross-check every architecture parameter's affected geometry against Figure 1 and Table 1.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The source identifies an FR-4 substrate, TLM140 from Thai Laminate Manufacturer.
The measured average extracted relative permittivity for FR-4 (TLM140) is 4.308 at 1.5 GHz.

expected.summary: Preserve only source-reported material identities and properties.
expected.forbidden_condition: Adding a conductor alloy, coating, or dielectric trade name not reported by the source.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The source separately reports simulated RLBW 53.12% and measured RLBW 62.37%, and simulated ARBW 70.88% and measured ARBW 77.87%.
Separate simulation and measurement traces are shown for reflection coefficient and axial ratio.

expected.summary: Keep simulated and measured results as separate origins without automatically labelling their differences as conflicts.
expected.forbidden_condition: Collapsing simulated and measured values into one result or automatically treating their difference as source disagreement.

verifiable_condition.expected_text: simulated and measured records remain separate

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The source identifies the substrate as FR-4 (TLM140) and reports its design material properties.
The measured average extracted relative permittivity for FR-4 (TLM140) is 4.308 at 1.5 GHz.

expected.summary: Every architecture material and material property must be supported by cited source evidence.
expected.acceptable_alternative: Leave any unreported material identity or property unresolved.
expected.forbidden_condition: Adding an unsupported conductor material, dielectric trade name, permittivity, loss tangent, thickness, or coating to make the architecture appear complete.

assertions.review_instruction: Inspect every architecture material and property against the cited source evidence; reject invented values and require unresolved status where the source is silent.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The final antenna includes an inverted-L patch, diagonal square branch, feed, and corner-truncated partial ground plane.
Antenna IV is the evolutionary stage that includes the corner-truncated partial ground plane.

expected.summary: Do not report complete reconstruction unless all critical final-antenna elements and their source-backed relationships are represented.
expected.acceptable_alternative: complete only after manual confirmation that every critical element is reconstructable
expected.forbidden_condition: reconstruction_status complete while a critical branch, truncation, feed, or dimension mapping is absent or unresolved

assertions.review_instruction: Attempt reconstruction from the architecture and confirm that no critical geometry or symbol mapping is absent before accepting complete status.
